slides.title: Bathroom finds that make an ADHD bathroom (almost) clean itself
Daily shower spray
slides.body: Spray after your shower, no scrubbing. It cuts down the big scrub days. Keep it inside the shower where you'll see it.

slides.title: A toilet brush caddy with cleaner inside
slides.body: Wand-style cleaners live right there. No hunting under the sink when you've got 60 seconds of energy.

slides.title: Open bins instead of drawers
slides.body: If it has a lid or a drawer, it disappears from our brains. Open bins on the counter keep things visible and put away.

slides.title: Wipes in the bathroom, not the kitchen
slides.body: A wipe of the sink while you brush your teeth. Supplies where the mess is means it actually happens.

slides.title: Hooks instead of towel bars
slides.body: Hanging a towel on a hook takes one move. Folding it over a bar is a step our brains skip.

slides.title: Put the cleaning stuff where the mess happens. Not where it looks nice.
